events.description: Bring the family for some Halloween fun at TUPPS! What is a Trunk or Treat? A group of cars with decorated and themed trunks. Families go from car to car for treats, games, and other Halloween fun. It’s a great alternative to trick or treating! Come out to TUPPS a little early or hang around after to have some lunch in The Grain Room. We’ve got a full menu…

events.title: Sunday Supper
events.description: IS CALLING! Nothing beats a good ol’ Sunday Supper! Join us every Sunday from 5–8 PM for downhome cookin’ from The Grain Room Kitchen, featuring a rotating menu of comfort food favorites. THIS WEEK: CATFISH PLATE! Come hungry, bring the family, grab a cold beer, and let us handle dinner. We’ll save you a seat!
